## Checklist

- [ ] Branch named `<me>/<thing>`; conventional commit messages
- [ ] Behaviour change → matching `docs/` file + BUILD-LOG entry updated in THIS PR
- [ ] No secrets / keys / tunnel URLs / stranger faces or plates (repo is public)
- [ ] Simulated pieces carry `sim_` prefix and are labelled in UI if visible
- [ ] Copy + comments pass the honesty ledger (docs/05 §6): "weapon-candidate", "lead", never "criminal identified"
- [ ] If this touches the API contract (docs/01 §5) or a locked decision: ADR proposed in `docs/adr.md`
